title: REEF / LIVE WIRE / OCEAN (EXTENDED BLUE MIX)
style:
124 BPM — Open Ocean Electro / WA Sunset Club Anthem

STYLE TAGS

124 BPM four-on-the-floor,
deep sidechained sub-bass,
bright coastal synth plucks,
engine hum texture intro,
funk guitar chops mid-section,
maronica seabird accents,
long filter builds,
extended mid-set drop,
boat-party anthem,
Indian Ocean energy,
aluminium hull resonance texture,
steel frame industrial undertone
lyrics:
[INTRO — LOW PASS KICK + ENGINE HUM + OCEAN SWELL]

Lines off.
Harbour quiet.
Throttle steady.

Aluminium hull catching first light.
Steel frame steady underneath.
Indian Ocean waiting.

Kick fades in.

[VERSE 1 — GROOVE LOCKED, CONTROLLED ENERGY]

Deck lights warming in the blue
Salt in the air, horizon true
Live Wire pulse in aluminium skin
Feel that vibration running within

Not borrowed culture
Not borrowed sound
This is WA water
Running ground to ground

From early weld sparks in the yard
To midnight bass hitting hard
Same coastline under our feet
Same tide beneath the beat

[PRE-CHORUS — FILTER RISING]

Feel the wake
Feel it rise
Ocean pressure in your eyes

Steel frame steady
Hull runs light
Indian Ocean
Owns the night

[DROP 1 — CLEAN ANTHEM]

Live Wire run
Feel the tide
Pelican rhythm
Ocean-wide

Reef to yard
Yard to reef
Aluminium heartbeat underneath

WA waterline
Side by side
Salt and bass
Amplified

[VERSE 2 — MORE ENERGY, CROWD ALIVE]

Aluminium hull cuts clean and fast
Steel frame built to last
Bassline rolling like open swell
Western coast knows it well

Deck shakes when the drop comes down
Laser light on open crown
Indian Ocean in ultraviolet
Every wave hits just right

No skyline noise
No borrowed hype
Just ocean air
And coastal type

[PRE-CHORUS — CALL AND RESPONSE]

Who runs deep? — Pelican
Who holds steady? — Captain
What runs under every beat? — WA heat

[DROP 2 — EXTENDED, HEAVIER]

Live Wire run
Ocean drive
Boat lights burning
Fully alive

Indian Ocean rhythm
Under every wave
Aluminium thunder
That’s how we behave

Reef to yard
Steel and spray
Western coast
Owns this day

[MID-SECTION — NU-DISCO GROOVE BREAK]

Funk bass kicks in.
Guitar chops.
Kick pulls back.

From early morning yard shift hum
To night-time party when the crowds come
Compliance tight and charts all clear
Now the music’s what you hear

Salt on skin and boots on deck
Every bass hit hits correct
This isn’t chance and it’s not luck
It’s WA built — built to run

[BUILD — LONG FILTER SWEEP]

Hands on rail
Hair in wind
Indian Ocean
Pulls you in

Hull resonance
Feel it hum
Steel frame grounded
Bassline drum

Rise…
Rise…
Rise…

[DROP 3 — PEAK MOMENT]

Live Wire pulse
Feel the wake
Pelican moving
No mistake

Aluminium skin
Ocean core
Western coast
Give me more

Reef to yard
Yard to reef
Every wave
On repeat

WA
WA
WA waterline

[HALF-TIME BREAK — SUB + SPOKEN]

Listen to the hull.
It talks in pressure.

Listen to the frame.
It holds the measure.

This isn’t a bar that floats for show.
It’s a line through the coast that we know.

Indian Ocean doesn’t bluff.
You earn its trust.
Or it’s enough.

[FINAL BUILD — FULL ENERGY RETURN]

Lights flash blue
Deck alive
Ocean pulse
Overdrive

Feel the coast
Feel the heat
Bassline heavy
Under feet

[FINAL DROP — LONG, CHANTABLE, CLOSER]

Live Wire run
Ocean ride
Pelican rhythm
Amplified

Aluminium hull
Steel frame spine
Indian Ocean
Every time

Reef to yard
Yard to reef
WA pulse
Underneath

Raise it high
Hold it tight
Western coast
Owns the night

Live Wire
Pelican
Indian Ocean
Again

[OUTRO — ENGINE HUM + SYNTH FADE]

Throttle down.
Deck lights fade.
Ocean steady.

Repeat tomorrow.
